fields.v: Proposes an approach; secondary: Compares — proposes Spec Kit Agents (multi-agent Spec Kit pipeline with discovery and validation context-grounding hooks) and evaluates it against Baseline, Augmented, Full (Spec Kit) and two ablations on 32 feature tasks in 5 repositories; SWE-bench Lite for Baseline and Augmented
fields.quote: We present Spec Kit Agents a multi-agent SDD pipeline (with PM and developer roles) that adds phase-level, context-grounding hooks.
fields.why: The authors present their own system as the main contribution, so the protocol value 'Proposes an approach' applies (rule of 2026-11-23); the field starts with 'Evaluates' while the detail itself says 'proposes and evaluates its own approach'.
fields.doubt: Os autores apresentam o seu próprio sistema (Spec Kit Agents) como contribuição principal. Pela regra de 23/11, a natureza deve começar por 'Proposes an approach', não 'Evaluates'. O Q13 já está pontuado como para uma proposta. Vê a pág. 1-2 e decide.

fields.v: Custom 32-task set; all runs Claude Code CLI 2.1.50 + MiniMax-M2.5; quality = LLM-judge composite 1-5 (Claude Opus 4.6), time = wall-clock on completed runs. Authors' criteria: run success = PR + >=1 file modified + no critical error (per-configuration success rates not reported); composite below 3.0 'requiring manual review'; no cost criterion stated (only budgets of 40/90 min, over-budget runs fail). (1) Baseline (no SDD) + Claude Code + MiniMax-M2.5: quality 3.46 (>=3.0); time 14.4 min. Quality works (above the authors' 3.0 review threshold); cost: no criterion stated by the authors. (2) Augmented (no SDD + hooks) + Claude Code + MiniMax-M2.5: 3.50; 15.5 min. Quality works (>=3.0); cost: no criterion stated by the authors. (3) Full (Spec Kit) + Claude Code + MiniMax-M2.5: 3.51; 24.0 min. Quality works (>=3.0); cost: no criterion stated by the authors. (4) Full-Augmented (Spec Kit Agents) + Claude Code + MiniMax-M2.5: 3.66; 37.2 min. Quality works (>=3.0); cost: no criterion stated by the authors. (5) Discovery-only (ablation): 3.53; 25.5 min. Quality works (>=3.0); cost: no criterion stated. (6) Validation-only (ablation): 3.57; 31.2 min. Quality works (>=3.0); cost: no criterion stated. Overall scores only; some per-repository scores below 3.0 not reported (lowest 3.10, Full on FastAPI). Test compatibility 99.7-100% across configurations (per-config values not given). SWE-bench Lite (Pass@1): (7) Baseline + Claude Code + MiniMax-M2.5: 56.5%; (8) Augmented + Claude Code + MiniMax-M2.5: 58.2%. Quality and cost: no criterion stated by the authors; cost not reported
fields.quote: Quality is assessed post hoc using the judge model; in analysis, composite scores below 3.0 are treated as requiring manual review.
fields.why: The verdicts are set by comparing configurations (e.g. '+0.04', '+13.2 min vs Full'), not each on its own against a criterion stated by the authors; the only quality cut-off given is 3.0, and no cost criterion is stated.
fields.doubt: Os veredictos atuais comparam configurações entre si (+0.04, +13.2 min), mas o protocolo pede cada configuração avaliada sozinha, só com critério dos autores. O único limiar de qualidade dado é 3.0 (revisão manual, pág. 3); para custo não há critério. Decide se usas o 3.0 como critério ou 'no criterion stated' também para a qualidade.
